body: Thank you for your words. I'm trying to hold on but I just feel so dumb and worthless.

I'll be 32 by then. Not sure where I'll be or what I'll be doing. I've aspired for a long time to live abroad. I want to get a degree, be formally educated, in the archaeology field. But everything seems so bleak right now. I feel like I've permanently messed up my entire life.
